svg.text: Two-mass model of a robot joint and the motor-side frequency response
Guide 23 · robot control system · values = examples / estimates (IRB 2600-20/1.65, J1)
J_M·θ̈_M = τ − k(θ_M − θ_L) − c(θ̇_M − θ̇_L) − τ_f
J_L·θ̈_L = k(θ_M − θ_L) + c(θ̇_M − θ̇_L) − τ_g − τ_contact
The controller sees only θ_M (motor encoder).
Gear twist θ_M − θ_L = τ/k is invisible to it:
